firm_data.firm_description: Rothman Law PLLC is a boutique law firm representing domestic and international clients in sophisticated real estate and finance transactions. They combine large-firm sophistication with the agility and personal attention of a boutique practice.
notable_facts: Represents owners, developers, investors, lenders, and funds
Advises on acquisitions, financings, developments, and leasing across all major asset classes

email.subject: AI for Rothman Law PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Sarah,

Rothman Law's focus on sophisticated real estate and finance transactions across major asset classes puts you in a position where precision and client trust are everything. We've found that boutique practices handling complex deals face the same document and contract demands as BigLaw, but with leaner teams.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for exactly this challenge. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: speed without sacrificing quality.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in NYC to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on deal velocity.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
